{3: "A whisper of sound stirred, barely audible. Some clumsy creature of the deep had strayed against the prison's outer shell."}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: "The camouflage sloughed away, and the abyssal world projected faithfully onto the transparent interior wall. Mottled light rippled over a young woman's silhouette, cloaking her in fractured patterns."}
{3: 'Her voice was barely a whisper.'}
{3: 'She paused for only a moment before carrying on with the story drawn from her memories.'}
{2: '????', 3: "I don't know what I'd do if it goes down. I don't know what I'd do if it just dies down there. But I have to do something. There are plenty of things I still can do...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Most of the sound was swallowed by the sea and the engineered walls. The fish dwelling in the deep and the person imprisoned within it inhabited the same silence, together in their apartness.'}
{1: '1', 2: '???', 3: 'Mother, when you finish the story, can we finally leave here?', 4: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1281.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1281.jpg'}

{3: "The young woman looked up. A distant moon lay in the embrace of a fabricated starry sky, while beyond it, the deep blue sea hung heavy like an eternal winter's night, bearing down on the database's dome."}
{2: '????', 3: 'Can anyone hear me?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The sea swallowed every sound.'}

{2: 'System Broadcast', 3: 'Current temperature: 3 degrees Celsius. North wind at force 6. Destination: New Murmansk. Estimated voyage: 14 hours. Passengers now boarding, please watch your step on the gangway and keep children and luggage with you at all times.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.8', 4: '0', 5: '0'}

{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory389.jpg'}
{3: 'The passenger liner sliced through the gray-blue water.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'The wind was merciless, laced with the deep cold of a winter morning and the untamed rage of the vast ocean, lashing at anyone who dared to sail. Clutching an infant to her chest, a green-haired young woman ducked her head and disappeared into the press of bodies on deck.'}
{3: 'She ditched her coat on an express line outside the port. Anything that could name her will be dispersed with the speeding trains.'}
{3: 'Now the cold worked through her, leaving her to tremble like a faltering flame. All she could do was clutch the baby to her chest and let their shared warmth be barely enough.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Female Stranger', 3: 'Oh, sweetheart... What are you doing out here dressed so thin? Are you by your—', 4: '2'}
{3: "The kind woman draped a coat over the young woman's shoulders, and in that gesture, as she leaned close, her gaze fell upon the baby's eyes."}
{2: 'Female Stranger', 3: '...', 4: '2'}

{3: "Those eyes did not meet hers, yet they pinned her in place, quiet with a stillness far older than any newborn. They were a forgotten sheet of lake ice on the endless tundra, with winter's light sealed beneath."}
{2: 'Green-Haired Young Woman', 3: '...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Like a frightened bird, she nodded hastily and made to escape from this kind but dangerous attention and vanish into the cabins.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBianHong.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'Beeeeep—'}
{3: 'The alarm began to wail.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'System Broadcast', 3: 'Mayday! Mayday! Mayday!'}
{2: 'System Broadcast', 3: 'This is Rommel, currently in North Atlantic Sector Four. We are taking on water. Requesting immediate assistance. Thirty-four souls on board.'}
{3: 'The rescue comms shattered like a hive torn apart, flooded with voices all at once.'}

{3: 'A man, voice raw, cried Mayday in endless repetition. Static cut through, and then a young woman sobbed out coordinates, her words breaking apart. The transmissions struggled against the storm, then slowly died away.'}
{2: 'Feeble Male Voice', 3: 'Mayday. Our hull is listing fifteen degrees now...'}
{2: 'Sobbing Female Voice', 3: "We've abandoned ship. Six of us on the life raft. It's so cold... P-please, just please, somebody save us..."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0'}

{3: 'Distress calls in different languages washed in like floodwater, only to be torn apart by static and roaring waves. They layered over each other until the entire communication channel was buried alive in pleas.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryHongBg.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg'}
{3: 'The coast guard stations along the Transatlantic coast stood empty. In the wake of the explosion that threatened to devour the world, only ruin stretched across the shore.'}
{3: 'Those desperate voices, hoarse, shaking, young, tearful, rose like specters on the swell and then drifted down into rooms that held no one.'}
{3: 'Rain hammered the vast ocean. Out beyond it all, only silence answered.'}

{1: 'Babylonia', 2: 'Present'}
{2: 'Babylonia\\nPresent'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: 'Surface Recon, this is Celica. Report on conditions around the moon rock strike zone.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The comms room churns with a snarl of signals, shuffling feet, and overlapping voices. On the wall, the maritime projection stutters in and out of darkness.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory612.jpg', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Recon Team Member', 3: '███▆▅▄...Can you hear me?', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Recon Team Member', 3: "▄▆▆▇███ getting worse... The Punishing Virus is spreading 126% faster than projected. It's already hit Sector Three. The blockade line had to fall back.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Recon Team Member', 3: 'The Punishing Virus leaking from the Atlantic Eye shows an 87% structural match with the Red Tide.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '11'}
{3: 'A piercing screech erupts over the channel, then fades rapidly into muffled noise.'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Thank you for your work out there.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Almost at once, another transmission forces its way in.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory46.jpg', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nikola', 3: 'Latest report.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Nikola', 3: 'Frontline squads just got hit. Two have gone dark.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Nikola', 3: 'Fiber-optic routing hubs and terminal stations along the Transatlantic coast are getting picked off one by one. An Ascendant is behind it.', 4: '11'}
{2: 'Nikola', 3: "That's on top of the infrastructure we already lost. Our communications authority over the Atlantic coastline and its waters is practically gone.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "...So every distress call we're picking up right now is only a fraction of what's actually happening?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nikola', 3: "Exactly. Pass this down. Expand all intel reception channels. Standard comm lines are about to fail, and we don't have time to waste.", 4: '11'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: '...Understood.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '11'}
{3: 'Celica slips her headset off and rubs the bridge of her nose.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'New Comms Officer', 3: 'Secretary General...', 4: '1'}
{3: "A girl edges up to Celica's desk, the strain audible in her voice."}
{2: 'New Comms Officer', 3: 'Late last night, we received 61 maritime transmissions. 43 were distress calls.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'New Comms Officer', 3: "We've handled the 36 that were closer to shore. The other 7, further out at sea... they're being routed now.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'New Comms Officer', 3: "It's just... the data doesn't look right. These distress coordinates are all converging toward the same point.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Celica looks up, her eyes heavy with exhaustion.'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "The comm lines went dead. We're only seeing scraps of the real picture out there...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "And the signals we can still pick up are way too few. We can't keep operating like this...", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Celica pauses for a moment.'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "...Issue a region-wide alert. Open up every comm channel we've got. Go.", 4: '2'}
{3: "Catching the unease on the girl's face, Celica lets her expression soften. Only now does it hit her: this girl is just a novice, pulled hastily from the Youth Center."}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "Look, the surface is our foundation. Kowloong, Akdilek... we still have allies there. Try not to worry. Humanity's going to face this together.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'New Comms Officer', 3: 'B-but the undersea cables... Can the TEC really—', 4: '1'}
{3: "Celica frowns, at a loss before the comms officer's panicked gaze, when hurried footsteps suddenly ring out."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "Babylonia isn't about to pin all its hopes on the Transatlantic crowd. That cartel of oligarchs has had the seas locked down for over twenty years.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Celica, we're running out of time.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: "The quantum-encrypted channel runs on pre-distributed entanglement. The system stashes away entangled pairs in advance, sure, a little rainy-day stockpile. But that cushion won't last long.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Once the entanglement reserves in the repeaters run dry, every military comm line riding the quantum network goes dead...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Karenina checks the time on her terminal and scowls. She pushes her pace faster, hurrying toward the military comms center.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'And in the time it took you to say all that, those backup reserves are already gone.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Oh, so it's my fault? Maybe the hardware whiz over here should've pushed quantum memory coherence time to its theoretical limit ages ago. Just a thought.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Two faces, both twisted with annoyance, let out a scoff in unison and turn sharply away.'}

{3: "The military's network communications system was originally built on quantum-encrypted channels. After the Punishing Virus outbreak, the already limited quantum fiber-optic network suffered widespread destruction."}

{3: 'The conventional and quantum fiber-optic systems along the Atlantic seabed, however, survived relatively intact and went on to carry 80% of surface traffic, along with a massive volume of military data.'}
{3: 'Unfortunately, when both systems fail simultaneously, the result is catastrophic.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: 'The quantum network flatlining is just a matter of time. Military comms should be in seriously bad shape...', 4: '1'}
{3: "A quiet sigh escapes Celica as the comms center's gates slide apart."}

{3: 'The hall is a burning forest. Alarms overlap in a shrill chorus. Green lights bleed to red, and error windows cascade open, piling into precarious towers that build themselves up only to shatter.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: 'And "bad shape" was still too optimistic.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Comms Officer A', 3: 'Monitoring Station 15 just went dark! Last data packet lost!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Comms Officer B', 3: "Inland station patrol squad's gone silent.", 4: '5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0'}
{2: 'Military Comms', 3: "...This is Whitefin... We've run into... Red Tide... Requesting backup... I say again, requesting... No... Luca's hit bad. We need to fall back..."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.8', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{3: 'A comms officer dashes to the station and slams the response key.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'New Comms Officer', 3: 'Whitefin, give me your exact coordinates! Do you copy?', 4: '1'}
{3: "The newcomer's panic is written plain across her face. A fellow officer at her side shakes head. The Whitefin squad on the other end never hears the response. The distress call soon goes dead."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0'}

{2: 'Military Comms', 3: "...Can't confirm friendly positions! I say again, can't confirm friendly positions! Lost contact with Heron Lake over thirty minutes ago. Last visual, they were heading southwest. After that, the Red Tide closed in between us..."}
{2: 'Military Comms', 3: "We've had no orders this whole time. We're moving to higher ground on our own! If anyone can hear this—"}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.8', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{3: 'A surge of static drowns the transmission entirely.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0'}
{2: 'Military Comms', 3: "...Comms down... Can't upload intel... We're pinned down... nearby waters... Corrupted everywhere, no way out..."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.8', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{3: 'Another transmission cuts to silence.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Comms Officer', 3: "Global latency is off the charts. The main backbone's coming apart... Trans-oceanic links down, cross-continent degraded seventy-three percent... We're completely in the dark now.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'New Comms Officer', 3: "Frontline squads can't hear our orders, and we've lost all real-time tracking on their positions... People are going to die. A lot of them...", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0'}

{2: 'Military Comms', 3: "Command, this is Begonia Star. Mission complete, data secured. No evac at extraction point. The Corrupted hit us... We've taken casualties. Data backup's been stashed on site."}
{2: 'Military Comms', 3: "This is Faye of Begonia Star... no, I'm the acting captain now. Captain... he's..."}
{3: 'A sob slips through as she amends her words.'}
{2: 'Military Comms', 3: 'Th-this is Faye, acting captain of Begonia Star. Transmission... o-over...'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.8', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{3: 'Her voice grows weaker, each word lighter than the last, until the faintest breaths die out quicker than the transmission.'}
{3: "Karenina's fist crashes down onto the console."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: 'So, anything? A way to fix... no, even just work around it?', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We open up access, and ground forces can scrape by on shortwave and laser for now... But the high-capacity two-way channel is already fried. And what little bandwidth we've still got is nowhere near enough.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We need military comms to check out the Atlantic Eye. That's where this whole Red Tide mess started. But the Red Tide is what killed our comms in the first place... So we're stuck in a dead loop.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Someone's gotta go in there. Right into the Red Tide and fix the undersea cables, or we're not going anywhere.", 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Five minutes later, the military communications center broadcasts its final public notice of the day.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: 'To all field units still in range. This is Secretary General Celica, with the latest directive from the Babylonia Parliament.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Celica', 3: "The global network is down. HQ intel support will not be available for now. We've unlocked all shortwave and laser comm channels. Use them to stay in contact on the surface.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'From this point on, every squad operates independently. Assess your own situation and make your own calls.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Celica looks down, her hand coming to rest softly against her chest.'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "I don't know how many of you can hear this... but until help gets to you, stay alive. Please. Just stay alive.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory175.png'}
{3: 'Alarms shriek without pause. Across the holographic displays, red markers track the spreading Red Tide. The Engineering Force stands fully mobilized.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "The Red Tide's eating through the cables way faster than we thought. Those quantum repeaters we're running are still the original Golden Age models. They're not gonna last much longer. Good news is, Asimov's already got the second-gen prototypes ready. We need to move fast and get them swapped out.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "The second-gen prototypes' memory coherence time is two orders of magnitude better than the last gen. And the real prize is they're packing the latest anti-Punishing Virus tech, straight out of the Omega Weapon program.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We're splitting into squads by target zone, moving out separately. The comms blackout's turning into a landslide, and guess whose job it is to dig us out. That's right. Us.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Does standing up there actually make the speech better?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Nobody asked you.', 4: '1'}
{3: "While the Engineering Force's cable repair squads are about to deploy, Teddy remains fixed at her desk, typing away without looking up."}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Those TEC people have really gone downhill. I've seen deep-sea fish write cleaner code than this. With their eyes closed.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Hideous. Absolutely hideous.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Give me two more days and my version of the protocol will be ready to go.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Two days? Princess, we don't even have two hours. Hey, newbie! That crate of gear too. Move it.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Seven or eight new recruits turn their heads in unison. All of them are pre-graduation technical trainees, pulled in at the last minute for this mission.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina's Inver-Device twitches uneasily."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'You. The newbie with the super long name. Yeah, you. That crate. And this one. Take both.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'From the crowd, a tall young recruit jerks upright, stiffening by instinct.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Yes, Captain!', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: "(...This many newbies? Yeah, this'll go great.)", 4: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}

{2: 'Teddy', 3: "No. I'm not letting you deploy with this fiber-optic protocol. Code like this is a personal attack. I'm coming with you. I'll finish the protocol on the ship. I'll get it done in time.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "I rewrote that fiber-optic protocol twelve times. Twelve. And you're telling me we're stuck using the Kraken Bloc's ugly mess instead?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Even the comments in this thing read like non-recyclable garbage.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Because they finished first and it actually works. That's why.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "This mission isn't a coding competition. You software types can just sit this one out and take it easy at home.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Oh? So you'd be fine if I actually did?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We'd be running around with the Sefirah, and I'd have to babysit you on top of everything else... Ugh. Just thinking about it gives me a headache.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Babysit me? Who was it that blew herself straight into the med bay during the last drill? I'm the one who should be worried about staying alive here.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'That was an accident! And it only happened because YOU screwed up the data!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Teddy', 3: "Data error or someone's sloppy execution, I'll be the judge of that.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Their eyes meet for only a second, and the bickering falls away, replaced by a silent understanding.'}
{3: 'Because of the Sefirah, Teddy has all but withdrawn from field duty. She never says it, but the thought of Karenina walking into such a dangerous mission alone sits heavily in her chest.'}
{3: 'And Karenina, in turn, would never let her vice-captain set foot on those treacherous waters like this.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Captain, we're ready to move out.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Instead of moving, Karenina folds her arms and turns her face aside, presenting Teddy with a richly expressive view of the back of her head.'}
{3: 'Teddy feels her terminal give a light buzz.'}
{1: 'Notice: Karenina has added you to her terminal firewall whitelist.', 3: '55'}
{2: 'Notice: Karenina has added you to her terminal firewall whitelist.'}

{3: "Teddy freezes for a beat. She looks away, her lips pressing into a dismissive pout, even as her fingers tap rapidly across the screen. A moment later, a half-finished fiber-optic protocol shows up on Karenina's terminal."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Your code's nothing special either, you know... Barely good enough to use as a lucky charm...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Teddy', 3: 'Just go already! Quit dragging your feet!', 4: '1'}
{3: "Karenina tilts her chin up and delivers a flat palm to the back of a rookie's head, the one who's been squatting there enjoying the show."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'You heard her, rookie! Move it! Quit dragging your feet!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1432.jpg'}
{1: 'Emergency Engineering Corridor', 2: 'Babylonia'}
{2: 'Babylonia, Emergency Engineering Corridor.'}

{3: "The Science Council's exclusive elevator locks into place at the Military Security Area's assembly level. It's one of the largest transit hubs, the primary relay between combat units, and the final waypoint before the battlefield."}
{1: '1', 3: "The door hisses open. Dark circles sit beneath the arrival's eyes, the unmistakable stain of a vicious, ungodly work schedule worn deep into the skin."}
{3: 'He looks one step away from the Star of Life ward, but the voice he aims at the other end of the line is blunt and unapologetic.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: "...I need ten minutes without any interruptions. Councilors, stop dressing up your panic like it's some kind of scientific curiosity and hovering around me. You'll get your answers. All of them.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He steps aside, clearing the way with a small nod. Moments later, a line of stretcher beds rolls into view.'}
{3: 'A Star of Life emergency team rushes past him, the wounded strapped in, wheels screeching harshly against the floor.'}
{3: 'Weaving through the harsh noise, soldiers in full combat gear pour past in the opposite direction, bound for the airfield and the front.'}
{3: 'In this endless loop of coming and going, life grows thinner, quietly slipping away one by one.'}
{3: 'Asimov stays where he is, eyes fixed on those retreating backs for a few long seconds.'}
{3: 'Then he looks away, unhurried, and rubs at his heavy shoulders.'}
{3: "Brisk footsteps and chattering comms fill the air. Yet when Asimov enters the Engineering Force's assembly area, the room goes silent for just one breath."}
{3: 'The girl glances around and, after a pause, gestures uncertainly toward herself.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Asimov rubs his forehead, the picture of severe sleep deprivation.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Yes, you. Captain Karenina.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'His glance sweeps across the assembly area.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: "Good, I haven't missed anything. I half expected you'd already be out the door. The Engineering Force's captain doesn't exactly have a reputation for sitting still.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Hah? What's that supposed to mean? You think I'm gonna mess this up?", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "I'm not worried about you messing up. It's more that... the mission itself is already borderline impossible. You're not dealing with a few broken cables. You're dealing with the entire ocean.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Asimov folds his arms and surveys the assembly area that seems conspicuously empty.'}
{3: 'The space accommodates seventy, but fewer than thirty bodies dot the floor.'}
{3: 'Equipment crates are lined up tidily nearby, each covered in red priority tags. They look oddly celebratory, like strings of Kowloong blessing slips.'}

{3: 'The turnout is worse than she imagined. But Karenina, leading the Engineering Force, recognizes that under current conditions, this is nearly the full roster of capable technical hands Babylonia can afford to send.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "We've tried to shorten the training cycle as much as possible. It's still not fast enough. The real problem is simple math. We lose you faster than we can train you.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Bleak as the assessment is, his tone remains even, delivering the reality without embellishment.'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "You and your team need to understand something. You're every bit as valuable as the equipment you're hauling. So get any heroic last-stand ideas out of your heads. At minimum, stay alive long enough to get dragged back to the Star of Life.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'When the question is hard to answer, Karenina just lets it hang there.'}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "The Cosmos Technicians Union and the Transatlantic Economic Community's internal teams will both be providing support. That said, I wouldn't expect it to improve things much.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Karenina, are you sure you want to lead this one yourself?', 4: '2'}
{3: "His words feel pointed in a way she does not like. Karenina's brow furrows. The Chief Technician is being strange, posing a question to which there is no second answer."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Of course.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "The Science Council's been getting ready for the second-gen repeater upgrade for ages.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "And I've been getting ready right along with you. My new frame was built with maritime ops in mind. So now that everything's falling apart, who else is supposed to take this on?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Asimov looks at her, a complicated expression settling over his face.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Your new frame is complete. It'll be dispatched directly to the mission coordinates before you arrive.", 4: '2'}

{3: "Karenina's attention drops to her terminal, where she scrolls through the fresh frame specifications. She misses the nearly invisible shift in Asimov's gaze, which is caught somewhere between reluctance and measured appraisal."}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'One more thing. I need to tell you this in person.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Someone accessed your Construct conversion surgery dossier recently.', 4: '2'}
{3: "Karenina's hand stops. She looks up, a small wrinkle of confusion between her brows."}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'The access came through a joint account. Transatlantic Economic Community and Science Council. Every account of that type should have been decommissioned twenty years ago.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'His voice stays even, but there is something strange threaded through it.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'And that account belongs to... Dr. Kalon.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Her pupils constricted sharply.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '...Grandpa?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'How... how is that even...?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Asimov shakes his head.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Karenina, Dr. Kalon is dead. That much is certain. But the account that accessed your dossier is also his. No question.', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V470liufenyiNormal01.png'}
{3: 'Without a pause for her to take it in, Asimov slips a hand inside his coat and produces something, offering it to her.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '...A sextant.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The brass is polished soft at the corners from long use, darkened with time. Not the one from Wise, but the workmanship matches perfectly.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '...Grandpa made this?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Before he became a pioneer in Construct technology, Dr. Kalon was better known as the Chief Advisor of the Transatlantic Ocean Engineering Institute.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Those creations known as the Atlantic masterworks, the Mannan series intelligent machines, the quantum repeater prototype... they all came from his team.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'A gift meant to keep one from ever losing their way in the ocean of truth. A shame, really...', 4: '2'}
{3: 'His gaze falls upon the sextant in her hand, yet it drifts further, as though he is watching a distant, fog-blanketed sea.'}
{3: "Karenina's grip tightens. The brass bites into her palm. She frowns at Asimov and holds her silence, waiting."}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'No one knows what happened to him while he was there.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'All I know is that when his term ended and he was transferred back to the Science Council, the man we got back was barely alive.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Ever since Arius launched the moon rock strike, the Red Tide from the Atlantic Eye has been spreading faster. That part you already know...', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'But the targeted sabotage of the fiber-optic repeaters only started two days ago. Right after that account accessed your dossier.', 4: '2'}
{3: "He pauses, letting his eyes find Karenina's face again."}

{2: 'Asimov', 3: "Karenina, Captain of the Engineering Force, Babylonia's top technical talent. When a global communications crisis hits, your name is on the list by default. I can't think of anyone else who could take your place.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'She watches him, catching the shape but not the weight of his words.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: "This could all be a coincidence. But more likely than not, it's a trap set for you.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'He asks the question again, in exactly the same tone as before.'}
{2: 'Asimov', 3: 'Karenina, are you sure you want to lead this one yourself? You have the right to say no.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Karenina, however, lets out a breath of relief.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "That's it? Here I thought you were about to drop something heavy on me... Tch, like I'd ever back down.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Whatever happened to Grandpa back then, whatever someone's got planned for me... it doesn't matter. The mess we're in right now still needs fixing. Someone's gotta do it.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "And if there's some scheme waiting? Fine. I'll find it, and then...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I'll blow its goddamn head off!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Karenina pockets the sextant Kalon made, not giving it another thought.'}
{3: "The assembly area is washed in pale, clinical light. At the corridor's distant end, another team is gearing up. Noise washes in and out like a far-off sea, swelling and retreating."}
{3: 'Asimov looks at the girl before him and gives a nod.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: "Then go. Try not to let your new frame's data rot at the bottom of the ocean.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He turns and walks toward the elevator, already reconnecting the call he cut off.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: "Alright, councilors. I'm back. You've got nine minutes left. Make them count.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "...The guy looks like he's about to check into the Star of Life ICU and he's still here lecturing me...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: "Karenina. I can still hear you. Also, your new frame's vestibular module hasn't been loaded with naval data yet.", 4: '18'}
{3: 'Asimov throws her a backward glance.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Asimov', 3: 'So if you get seasick, try not to stand on deck cursing at the sea.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Wh—Hey! Hey! HEY!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'At the far end of the corridor, the elevator doors part again. Asimov disappears into them, and a fresh wave of soldiers spills out.'}
{3: 'Each one is a stubborn, brilliant flame that refuses to die out.'}
